title: GDScript: Add Code Actions and "Quick Fix" actions for warnings/errors (re-do for reviews)

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Same as https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114168, which was reverted due to not having a GDScript team review.

---

Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/13232 .

This PR adds support for "Code Actions" and "Quick Fixes" in Godot's script editor, for GDScript. This aims to work similarly to [VS Code's Code Actions](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editing/refactoring).

Essentially, when a GDScript warning is pushed, a list of Code Actions can optionally be supplied as well. These will be offered to the user via a lightbulb icon that appears in the script editor gutter. The option to suppress the warning with `@warning_ignore` is often provided, and depending on the warning, a more specific fix may also be provided.

Currently the following fixes are provided:

- UNUSED_VARIABLE
  - Add underscore to variable name
  - Remove variable declaration
- UNUSED_PARAMETER
  - Add underscore to parameter name
- MISSING_TOOL
  - Add `@tool`
- GET_NODE_DEFAULT_WITHOUT_ONREADY
  - Add `@onready`
- UNUSED_PRIVATE_CLASS_VARIABLE
  - Remove underscore from class variable name
  - Remove class variable declaration
- UNTYPED_DECLARATION
  - Add type specifier
- INFERRED_DECLARATION
  - Add type specifier
- UNUSED_LOCAL_CONSTANT
  - Add underscore to constant name
  - Remove constant declaration
- ASSERT_ALWAYS_TRUE
  - Remove assert statement
- REDUNDANT_AWAIT
  - Remove "await"
- ~~STATIC_CALLED_ON_INSTANCE~~
  - ~~Call from type~~
- MISSING_AWAIT
  - Add "await"

## To Do

- [x] Ensure that multi-line variable declarations are removed properly
- [ ] Ensure placement of code actions button is correct

## For future PRs

These are things that would be nice to add in future PRs but are **out of scope for this PR:**

- View and run code actions associated with warnings in the warning panel
- Create function stubs to match nonexistent referenced functions
- Create signals to match nonexistent referenced signals
- Create properties to match nonexistent referenced properties(?)
